w10_T4_002406: On Monday morning a bookshop counted 6 display shelves with 97 books on each shelf. At midday a delivery added 21 books to those shelves. During the afternoon 269 books were sold from them. In the evening a school returned 70 books, all of which went straight back onto the same shelves. A dozen customers were still browsing when the shop closed. How many books were on those shelves at closing time?
w10_T4_002409: A village choir had sold 16 tickets for its opening night by the end of January. It sold 70 more in February and another 15 in early March. Then 11 buyers cancelled, and a school block booking added 33 tickets. Every ticket costs 5 dollars, and the rehearsal begins half an hour before the doors open. The choir performed on 6 nights in all, and each night sold exactly that same number of tickets at that same price. How many dollars did the choir take altogether?
w10_T4_002413: The Redhill cycling club stored 215 water bottles at its north depot, and a sponsor delivered 66 more to that same depot. The club keeps 2 depots in total, and the south depot holds exactly the same number of bottles as the north one. The club has been running for 38 years. At the spring race 91 bottles were handed out to riders. A charity later collected 242 bottles from the club. How many bottles does the club still have?
w10_T4_002423: Amir had 25 pencils in his case, and 1 of them snapped in half and was thrown away. His classmate Bea gave him 59 pencils from a bulk pack she had bought, far more than Amir had started with. He handed 36 of those pencils to the younger class and left 5 of them in the art room. The school orders its pencils by the gross rather than by the single pencil. There are 28 desks in Amir's classroom. How many pencils are in Amir's case now?
w10_T4_002431: Early on Saturday morning the community centre counted 144 chairs, and 2 of them were broken and taken away. Before lunch a neighbour lent the centre 30 more chairs. In the afternoon all the chairs were divided equally among the 4 halls. That evening 14 folding chairs were carried into the first hall, and a late delivery added another 64 chairs to that same hall. The centre lists its opening times in minutes rather than in hours on the noticeboard. How many chairs were in the first hall by the end of the day?
w10_T4_002432: A school art teacher opened 5 pads of paper with 123 sheets in each pad. The sheets were shared equally among the 3 art classes. In one of those classes every sheet was cut into 4 greeting cards. Those cards were packed equally into 5 boxes, and the teacher spent half an hour tying them with ribbon. A parent then added 56 ready-made cards to one of the boxes. How many cards are in that box?
w10_T4_002434: Marisol's workshop received 80 planks of pine, and 42 of them were too warped to use. Each good plank was cut into 5 shelves, which was more shelves than her partner Diego managed in the whole month. A furniture shop then bought 128 of the shelves. Every shelf still in the workshop can hold 4 books, and Marisol measures each one in centimetres rather than in metres. She also owns a single wall rack with room for 10 more books. How many books can be held in Marisol's workshop altogether?
w10_T4_002435: On Monday morning Tara had 45 jars of jam ready for the fair. She sold 25 of them at the early market. In the afternoon she made 68 more jars. Her sister Wendy had prepared exactly the same number of jars as Tara was holding by then, and the 2 sisters put all of their jars onto one stall. In the evening their father brought 18 extra jars to the stall. How many jars were on the stall that evening?
w10_T4_002441: A podcast archive began the year with 183 episodes. The team recorded 32 more in the spring, then removed 82 old episodes that had gone out of date. A merger brought in 55 episodes from another show, and 39 bonus episodes were added in the autumn. The studio has 4 microphones on its desk. Every episode in the archive runs for exactly 9 minutes, and the archive states its total length in minutes rather than in hours. What is the total length of the archive in minutes?
w10_T4_002443: Early on Thursday morning an orchard packed 69 crates with 8 apples in each crate. The orchard has 90 apple trees in its oldest field. By midday the apples had been shared equally among 4 schools. In the afternoon a farmer dropped off another 69 apples at the first school, and it took him half an hour to unload them. That evening the first school cut every apple it had into 4 pieces for sports day. How many pieces of apple did the first school have?
w10_T4_002445: Kofi counted 228 bricks in the yard, and Lena wheeled in 17 more, far fewer than Kofi had counted. A neighbour took 66 bricks away for a garden path, and 23 more were found to be cracked and were discarded. Each brick still in the yard weighs 8 kilograms. The yard always gives its loads in kilograms rather than in tonnes. What is the total weight, in kilograms, of the bricks left in the yard?
w10_T4_002459: Hugo's laundry runs 3 identical vans, and on Monday each van collected 204 towels, all of which went into one pile. His colleague Sadia added 31 towels from the gym, a smaller load than any of the vans had brought. A hotel then sent 47 towels to the same pile, and a guesthouse sent another 47 later that day. The laundry weighs its work in kilograms rather than in pounds. How many towels were in the pile?
w10_T4_002468: Every one of the 8 beehives on Omar's farm produced 86 jars of honey, and all of the jars went into a single shed. Omar sold 559 jars at the summer market. His neighbour Rita repaid an old debt with 62 jars, which she stacked in the same shed. A wholesaler then collected 153 jars from the shed. How many jars are left in the shed?
w10_T4_002472: Bilal set out with 179 leaflets for the town fair. He handed 92 of them to shoppers on the high street, and the wind blew 48 more out of his bag. His friend Yara, who had started with far fewer leaflets than Bilal, gave him the 49 she still had. Each leaflet carries 9 coupons that can be torn off, and a dozen shops in town accept them. The fair runs for 3 days every summer. How many coupons was Bilal carrying?
w10_T4_002478: A garden centre had 165 tulip bulbs in its store, and a supplier delivered 71 more. All of the bulbs were then shared equally among the 4 display beds. Squirrels dug up 7 bulbs from the first bed. The centre opened its new cafe 3 months ago. Every bulb still in the first bed will produce 2 flowers. How many flowers will the first bed produce?
w10_T4_002480: A concert hall has 8 tiers, and each tier holds 236 seats. For a sold-out show the organisers added 76 folding chairs at the back. They squeezed in 64 more chairs along the side aisles and 19 in the orchestra pit. A balcony that had been closed for years reopened with 71 seats, and half of them face the stage directly. How many seats were available for that show?
w10_T4_002483: On the morning of the trip, 9 classes arrived at the park gates with 95 students in each class. By late morning 63 parents and teachers had joined the group as well. At the ticket office every person in the group needed 3 separate entry tickets, one for each attraction. Each of those tickets cost 7 dollars. In the afternoon the park applied a group discount that took 1440 dollars off the bill, and in the evening a booking fee of 59 dollars was added. What was the final cost of the trip in dollars?
w10_T4_002495: At the start of Monday the campsite had 213 tents pitched on the meadow. During the morning new arrivals pitched 42 tents, and 25 more went up before lunch. In the afternoon 71 groups packed up and drove away. In the evening a coach party arrived and pitched 69 tents. The campsite has 5 washblocks along the river. How many tents were pitched by the end of the day?
w10_T4_002501: A youth club's trip fund started the term with 30 dollars. A cake sale added 68 dollars, and 59 dollars were spent on paint. The club has 9 branches, and every branch raised exactly the same amount as this one, with all of it going into one shared fund. The shared fund then paid 210 dollars for a coach. A raffle brought in 51 dollars and a car wash another 20 dollars, and the treasurer records everything in dollars rather than in cents. Half of the club's members joined only this year. How many dollars are in the shared fund now?
w10_T4_002504: A smallholder kept 47 hens and bought 27 more at the spring auction. She sold 65 hens to a neighbouring farm, and a fox took 3 more. Each hen she has left lays 4 eggs a week. She also buys 32 eggs a week from a friend to make up her order. Every egg is sold for 6 pence, because her stall lists prices in pence rather than in pounds. How many pence does she take each week?
w10_T4_002505: A cannery received 130 crates of peaches in the morning and exactly the same number again in the afternoon, so 2 shipments arrived that day. All of those crates were shared equally among the company's 5 shops. The shop on Mill Street then took in 50 crates from a cancelled order and 72 crates from the old store room. Its records are kept in single crates rather than in pallets. Over the weekend the Mill Street shop sold 159 crates. How many crates does the Mill Street shop have left?
w10_T4_002507: Jonas had 58 model bricks, and his cousin Priya gave him 20 more, which was fewer than he already had. He lost 6 of them down a drain and glued 70 of them into a bridge that he will never take apart. Each brick he still has loose can be split into 3 smaller blocks. He then found 20 more loose blocks in an old box under his bed. Every block has 2 studs on its top face. The set was made 24 years ago. How many studs are on his loose blocks?
w10_T4_002518: Nadeem printed 3 batches of posters with 200 posters in each batch. His partner Elise added 54 posters that she had printed at home, fewer than any one of Nadeem's batches. Every poster in the pile was sold for 5 dollars. The money was then divided equally among the 5 clubs that had helped at the sale. The drama club, one of those 5, spent 248 dollars on costumes and later received a 57 dollar refund from a supplier. How many dollars does the drama club have now?
w10_T4_002525: A stationery warehouse stores 49 pens in every tray. Each shelf holds 8 of those trays, and each rack holds twice as many pens as a single shelf. Every aisle contains 9 identical racks. The warehouse has 7 aisles, all stocked in exactly the same way. How many pens does the warehouse hold?
w10_T4_002526: Ana bottles 92 litres of olive oil on each of the 5 pressing days in November. A restaurant bought 426 litres of it before the month was out. Her brother Luis, whose grove produces far less than Ana's, returned 61 litres that he could not sell. A late pressing added 27 more litres to Ana's store. The stone press in the yard is 60 years old, and Ana always records her stock in litres rather than in millilitres. How many litres of oil does Ana have?
